headline: Data center prohibition ordinance, Chapter 28 fee updates including dog licenses, and an equitable housing needs assessment.
summary: The council will discuss a draft data center prohibition, changes to Chapter 28 fees, and a housing needs assessment. It will also consider a letter of support for electric vehicle fast chargers at City Hall.
items: Approve payroll warrant for October 11 to October 24, 2026
Approve accounts payable warrant as of October 29, 2026
Approve resolution for the 2026 Small Business Saturday
Approve resolution recognizing National Native American Heritage Month in Winooski
Approve resolution recognizing November as Veterans and Military Families Month in Winooski
Approve Finance Commission appointment of Angela Aldieri, Finance Director
Discuss Equitable Housing Needs Assessment presentation
Discuss Chittenden County Regional Planning Commission annual report and budget review
Discuss and approve letter of support for electric vehicle fast chargers at City Hall, to be installed, owned, and operated by a private company
Discuss goal updates for safe, healthy, connected people; municipal infrastructure; and housing
Discuss and approve introduction of update ordinance for Chapter 28 fees, including dog licenses
